Core Active Vocabulary (6 items):

thirty — the number 30. Example: Thirty people work here.
forty — the number 40. Example: The book costs forty euros.
price — how much something costs. Example: The price is ten dollars.
cost — to have a price. Example: How much does it cost?
dollar — the money of the USA. Example: It costs five dollars.
euro — the money of many European countries. Example: That is twenty euros.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• How much is it?
• It costs ...
• That is too expensive.
• Do you have a cheaper one?
• Here is your change.
